about.name: Coach Jonathan Boone
about.title: DC/DB
about.bio:
Coach Jonathan Boone is a proven 4-2-5 specialist with 8 years of coaching experience at White Oak HS (TX). Known for a disciplined, film-first approach, Coach Boone develops intelligent, technically sound players who make an impact on every down.

If you're looking to elevate your game on the defensive side of the ball and compete at the next level, Coach Boone's coaching is where that journey starts.

hero.headline: White Oak HS (TX)'s Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized defensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: 4-2-5 Defense Installation
services.description: Full 4-2-5 system installation — formations, assignments, stunts, and blitz packages tailored to your personnel.

services.title: Film & Opponent Scouting
services.description: Tendency charting, defensive game-planning, and film breakdown sessions that give your defense the edge before kickoff.

services.title: Linebacker & Secondary Development
services.description: Position-specific coaching for front-seven and DB players — gap control, coverage technique, communication, and tackling.
